messages:
Hannah: Tiny life update — were expecting a baby in November and also just put an offer on a house in Seattle. Lots of happy chaos ahead! 3893fb3eb
Eli: WHOA congrats Hannah!! Thats massive news, double celebrations incoming 389. Whens the move?
Hannah: Thanks!! Were aiming to move late Sept. Plan is to be remote-first for a few weeks, then split time between SF and Seattle.
Rita: Huge congrats 60d Also we should absolutely do a hybrid baby shower + housewarming. Anyone willing to help organize?
Ben: I volunteer to coordinate desserts. Also will take copious photos of you lugging moving boxes for posterity.
PeopleOps: Congrats Hannah! PeopleOps note: parental leave eligibility and relocation assistance options are available — DM me and Ill send the checklist. We can also coordinate a group gift and a digital card.
Hannah: Thank you! DMing now. For the group card, please drop one-sentence notes here and Ill compile.
Eli: "Youre going to be the calmest new parent ever." — Eli
Rita: "May your boxes be light and your naps long." — Rita
Ben: "Congrats! Free dessert contribution pledged." — Ben
OpsBot: Reminder: If hosting any in-office event, reserve community table via the internal booking tool. No open flames; please clear area by 5pm for cleaning crew.
Hannah: Good to know. For the hybrid shower idea, would a weekday lunch or weekend afternoon work better?
Eli: Weekday lunch for me. Easier to pop in during the day.
Rita: Weekend afternoon preferred but can do weekday if needed.
CalendarBot: Poll created: "Hannah's Hybrid Shower Time" (link: https://doodle.example/xyz). Expires in 48 hours.
Ben: Also pro tip: small houseplants make cute housewarming gifts and survive move stress better than fragile decor.
Hannah: Love the plant idea. Also if anyone has good Seattle neighborhood tips, send them my way 604
Eli: Ballard food scene is great. Also bring rain boots.
Rita: Congrats again Hannah!! Such joyous news. Sending a tiny virtual hug 970
Hannah: Thank you all. Really appreciate the support — feels like a huge group hug in thread form. Will share details after Doodle closes.
PeopleOps: Sending the HR checklist now. Congrats again on both milestones!
